From 0d4416446897a91bb19ba837b97b607caea59a8f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert@linux-m68k.org>
Date: Mon, 10 Feb 2020 10:30:27 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] spi: pxa2xx: Enable support for compile-testing

m68k/allmodconfig:

    WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for SPI_PXA2XX
      Depends on [n]: SPI [=y] && SPI_MASTER [=y] && (ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI [=n] || ACPI)
      Selected by [m]:
      - SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH [=m] && SOUND [=m] && !UML && SND [=m] && SND_SOC [=m] && SND_SOC_INTEL_MACH [=y] && (SND_SOC_INTEL_HASWELL [=n] || SND_SOC_SOF_BROADWELL [=m]) && I2C [=m] && (I2C_DESIGNWARE_PLATFORM [=m] || COMPILE_TEST [=y]) && (GPIOLIB [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=y]) && (X86_INTEL_LPSS || COMPILE_TEST [=y]) && SPI_MASTER [=y]

This happens because SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH selects SPI_PXA2XX,
and the former depends on COMPILE_TEST, while the latter does not.

Fix this by enabling compile-testing for SPI_PXA2XX.

Fixes: 630db1549356f644 ("ASoC: Intel: bdw-rt5677: fix Kconfig dependencies")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert@linux-m68k.org>
Reviewed-by: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20200210093027.6672-1-geert@linux-m68k.org
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/spi/Kconfig b/drivers/spi/Kconfig
index d6ed0c355954..912cd6e35726 100644
--- a/drivers/spi/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/spi/Kconfig
@@ -551,7 +551,7 @@ config SPI_PPC4xx
 
 config SPI_PXA2XX
 	tristate "PXA2xx SSP SPI master"
-	depends on (ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI)
+	depends on ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI || COMPILE_TEST
 	select PXA_SSP if ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP
 	help
 	  This enables using a PXA2xx or Sodaville SSP port as a SPI master
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/spi/Kconfig`**
   - The dependency line for the `SPI_PXA2XX` configuration was modified. 
   - The original line:
     ```plaintext
     depends on (ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI)
     ```
   - The modified line:
     ```plaintext
     depends on ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI || COMPILE_TEST
     ```
   - This change adds `COMPILE_TEST` as a valid dependency for the `SPI_PXA2XX` configuration, allowing it to be compiled in configurations where compile testing is enabled.

### Relationships

- The modification addresses a warning related to unmet direct dependencies for `SPI_PXA2XX` when it is selected by `SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH`, which depends on `COMPILE_TEST`. By adding `COMPILE_TEST` to the dependencies of `SPI_PXA2XX`, the patch ensures that `SPI_PXA2XX` can be compiled in scenarios where compile testing is enabled, thus resolving the dependency issue highlighted in the warning. This change is part of a broader effort to fix Kconfig dependencies as noted in the commit message.

This happens because SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH selects SPI_PXA2XX,
and the former depends on COMPILE_TEST, while the latter does not.

Fix this by enabling compile-testing for SPI_PXA2XX.

Fixes: 630db1549356f644 ("ASoC: Intel: bdw-rt5677: fix Kconfig dependencies")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert@linux-m68k.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the `SPI_PXA2XX` configuration not having `COMPILE_TEST` as a dependency, which led to unmet direct dependencies when it was selected by `SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH`, a configuration that depends on `COMPILE_TEST`. This mismatch prevented successful compile-testing of the `SPI_PXA2XX` driver in certain configurations.

Here is the patch:
 config SPI_PXA2XX
 	tristate "PXA2xx SSP SPI master"
-	depends on (ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI)
+	depends on ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI || COMPILE_TEST
 	select PXA_SSP if ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP
 	help

```

```
```c
depends on COMPILE_TEST
```
Reason:
The `SPI_PXA2XX` configuration does not include `COMPILE_TEST` as a dependency, which creates a conflict when it is selected by `SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH`, a configuration that requires `COMPILE_TEST`. This mismatch results in unmet direct dependencies, preventing successful compile-testing of the `SPI_PXA2XX` driver.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
depends on ARCH_PXA || ARCH_MMP || PCI || ACPI || COMPILE_TEST
```
Reason:
By adding `COMPILE_TEST` to the dependencies of `SPI_PXA2XX`, the configuration now aligns with the requirements of `SND_SOC_INTEL_BDW_RT5677_MACH`, allowing for successful compile-testing in configurations that include `COMPILE_TEST`. This resolves the unmet dependency issue.
